---
title: Marinated Salted Cod
id: MAR-0004
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 400 g of salted cod
- 2 dl of white wine vinegar
- 3 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 1 teaspoon of green peppercorns
- 1 teaspoon of pink peppercorns
- 10 chives
- 1 small spring onion
## Method
1. Dry the salted cod, slice it thinly and place it in a bowl in layers, alternating with a little pink and green pepper and moistening with the vinegar.
2. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let marinate in the refrigerator for one hour.
3. Drain the salted cod and place it gently on a serving dish, sprinkling with the thinly sliced spring onion and snipped chives.
4. Season with extra virgin olive oil and serve.
